Vendored third-party libraries — pinned versions, sources, licenses
=====================================================================

dexie.min.js
  Version: 4.0.11
  Source:  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dexie@4.0.11/dist/dexie.min.js
  License: Apache-2.0
  Project: https://dexie.org

chart.umd.min.js
  Version: 4.4.7
  Source:  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.7/dist/chart.umd.min.js
  License: MIT
  Project: https://www.chartjs.org

xlsx.full.min.js
  Version: 0.18.5
  Source:  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/xlsx@0.18.5/dist/xlsx.full.min.js
  License: Apache-2.0
  Project: https://sheetjs.com




Pinned intentionally: bumping any of these requires re-vendoring and
re-testing offline behavior (the service worker precaches these exact
file names and bytes). xlsx.full.min.js is the one exception: it is not
precached, because it is lazy-loaded on the first Excel export and then
cached by the fetch handler.

Removed: Tesseract.js and its ~5.8 MB of WASM core and trained data.
It was vendored to read the weight off a scale photo, but general OCR
cannot read seven-segment displays at all; on a correctly cropped,
upright photo of a display reading 142.7 it returned "2". That job is
now done by js/sevenseg.js, which decodes the segments geometrically
and needs no model, no download and no network.
